landing.features.label: Features
landing.features.title:
Everything TV Time had.
Plus what it never did.
landing.features.sub: Built by a frustrated TV Time user, for frustrated TV Time users.
landing.f1.title: Episode-by-episode tracking
landing.f1.desc: Check off episodes individually, mark entire seasons at once, rate each episode with stars, and leave per-episode comments. Auto-status updates as you progress.
landing.f2.title: Release calendar
landing.f2.desc: See what to catch up on, what's airing next, and abandoned shows — all in one calendar view. Mark watched directly from the list.
landing.f3.title: Detailed stats
landing.f3.desc: Hours watched, episodes seen, average rating, top genres, weekly activity chart, and your top 5 rated titles.
landing.f4.title: Multi-source search
landing.f4.desc: One search bar for everything. Results come from TMDB, AniList, RAWG, Google Books, and Spotify — add anything instantly.
landing.f5.title: Public profiles
landing.f5.desc: Share your profile at /profile/yourhandle. Others can see your favorites, reviews, and activity — and like your comments.
landing.f6.title: Dark mode + FR/EN
landing.f6.desc: Full dark and light theme. App available in French and English with auto-detection from your browser.
landing.f7.title: Games panel
landing.f7.desc: Track hours played and mark tiers as done or undone — built specifically for game tracking, not just a port of the show view.
landing.f8.title: Comments & reviews
landing.f8.desc: Leave notes on individual episodes or entire works. Like others' comments on public profiles. Your journal, your way.
landing.f9.title: Real-time sync
landing.f9.desc: Your data stays in sync across all your devices instantly.
landing.import.h3: Migrate from TV Time in minutes
landing.import.p: TV Time lets you export your data as a ZIP. Jilu parses it completely — shows, statuses, ratings, favorites — and imports everything automatically.
landing.import.detail: Imports: show list · ratings · favorites · watch status · special statuses

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.s2.intro: When using Jilu, the following data is collected:
legal.privacy.s2.li1: Account: email address, display name or username
legal.privacy.s2.li2: Content: media library (anime, movies, series), notes, ratings, watch history
legal.privacy.s2.li3: Public profile: if enabled, username and library visible to all visitors
legal.privacy.s2.note: No payment data, tracking cookies, or location data is collected.
legal.privacy.s3.li1: Service operation and personalization (legal basis: contract performance)
legal.privacy.s3.li2: Account-related communication, e.g. password reset (legal basis: contract performance)
legal.privacy.s4.vercel: The interface is hosted on Vercel (Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA).
legal.privacy.s4.firebase: Data (authentication, database) is hosted on Google Firebase (Firebase Authentication, Firestore), infrastructure of Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA.
legal.privacy.s4.note: Both providers act as data processors under the GDPR. Appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses) govern transfers outside the EU.
legal.privacy.s5.p: Data is retained until account deletion. Deletion can be requested from the Account page or by email.
legal.privacy.s6.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
legal.privacy.s6.li1: Right of access to your data
legal.privacy.s6.li3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
legal.privacy.s6.contact_mid: . If you have a complaint, you can contact the
legal.privacy.s7.p: Jilu only uses session data stored locally (localStorage / IndexedDB) strictly necessary for authentication. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

legal.terms.s5.p: Jilu strives to maintain service availability but cannot be held liable for interruptions due to maintenance, technical issues, or external factors. The service is provided "as is" without any guarantee of results.
legal.terms.s6.p: Jilu's interface, logo and source code are protected by intellectual property law. Reproduction without authorization is prohibited. Media metadata (posters, titles, descriptions) comes from third-party services (TMDB, AniList) subject to their own terms.

landing.faq.label: FAQ
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.a1: Yes, completely free. No subscription, no premium tier, no hidden fees.
landing.faq.q2: What can I track on Jilu?
landing.faq.a2: Series, films, anime, manga, books, and video games — all in one place, episode by episode.
landing.faq.q3: Is Jilu a TV Time alternative?
landing.faq.a3: Yes. Jilu was built by a TV Time user as a free replacement. It covers all the same features plus detailed stats, a release calendar, and public profiles.
landing.faq.a4: Yes. Jilu is a PWA — install it on iOS or Android directly from your browser, no app store needed.
landing.faq.q5: Can I import my TV Time data?
landing.faq.a5: Yes. Export your TV Time data, upload the ZIP to Jilu, and your entire watch history imports in seconds.
